verdict.line: You lose if you E into his Q swings without commitment reads or overreach before level 6; you win nearly every extended trade once you land a spirit and force the Tentacle math.

brief.thesis: Illaoi wins this lane through E (Test of Spirit) echo damage and Tentacle uptime, not raw trades, and the 55.4% win rate over 1150 games confirms it. Renekton's Fury-gated W (Ruthless Predator) and R (Dominus) give him real spike windows, but until he hits those thresholds his Q (Cull the Meek) sustain can't outpace a spirit-echoed E plus Tentacle chip.

theirWindow.what: His W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a 3-hit stun that shreds shields and his Q heal/damage spikes hard. Don't stand still through a full W-Q-E combo in this state; disengage or pre-commit your own E first.

yourWindow.when: He dashes in with E (Slice and Dice) on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Slice and Dice is his only gap closer/escape at 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown. The instant he uses it to engage, land your own E (Test of Spirit) and hold W (Harsh Lesson) to leap in behind Tentacle swings while he has no dash to reset the fight.

powerCurve.note: Neither combo online, trade with autos only
E echo damage outpaces his below-50-Fury Q sustain
Dominus plus 50+ Fury W spikes hurt
Tentacle stacking and item spikes take over
R (Leap of Faith) teamfight Tentacles dominate

start.why: Picked in 62.6% of games at 55.5% win rate; the lifesteal offsets Renekton's Q sustain in early poke exchanges.

boots.why: 69.3% pick rate at 53.5% win rate; the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts his Q swings and empowered W stuns.

core.why: First-built in the top core path (63.7% win rate over 193 games); armor shred stacks with Tentacle procs to accelerate his death timer.
Second item in both top-tier paths; the spellblock proc adds burst to your W-E-Tentacle chain and gives you an AoE slow to punish his Fury-dumped engages.
Third item in the top two paths; the shield and tenacity keep you alive through empowered W stun-lock attempts once he's 50+ Fury.

situational.when: he builds lifesteal or the game goes long and his Q sustain becomes a problem
you need to survive his all-in burst from empowered W into R
you want an earlier proc-based spike before committing to the Cleaver/Iceborn line
his team stacks hard CC beyond his own W stun

runes.keystoneWhy: Run at 55.1% win rate and 49.8% pick; the proc-and-sustain loop matches Illaoi's short-cooldown W (4s) engage pattern and out-sustains his Q healing over the laning phase.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash posts the highest measured win rate in this matchup at 61.2%... wait, that's Flash+Ignite; Exhaust+Flash sits at 56.5% over a larger 24.2% pick sample and directly neuters his empowered W-into-R all-in once he hits level 6.

playing.title: Bait Slice and Dice before committing
playing.detail: Since his E is his only dash at 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown, force him to use it on a wave or a half-engage before you walk up for your own E or W.

playing.title: E him the instant he dashes in
playing.detail: Test of Spirit's spirit echo damage punishes any all-in he starts, and since Slice and Dice is now down he can't disengage from it.

playing.title: Track his Fury bar every trade
playing.detail: Below 50 Fury his Q and W are weak pokes; above 50 his W becomes a 3-hit shield-destroying stun and his Q heal doubles, so don't stand in extended exchanges at that threshold.

playing.title: Don't fight through his level 6 spike
playing.detail: Dominus gives him bonus health and AoE damage on cast; play for spirit resets and Tentacle chip rather than a stand-and-trade until you have your first back.

playing.title: Use W to punish his stun windup
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson's 400-range leap plus nearby Tentacle swings lets you close distance fast right after he whiffs or commits his empowered W.

playing.title: Prioritize E on cooldown once ahead
playing.detail: At 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown, landing E repeatedly during trades snowballs the echo damage and threatens the Vessel/Tentacle spawn if he can't peel off the spirit in time.

playing.title: Group Tentacles for your R timing
playing.detail: Leap of Faith spawns a Tentacle per champion hit, so save it for skirmishes near his existing Tentacles rather than opening with it solo.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reads on Fury thresholds, cooldown windows, and trade sequencing are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Rather than engaging in first, use your [E] when he uses his (E) to brawl. Even if Renekton deals his full combo and falls back with (E), deal damage to his spirit from [E] to fight back. However, Renekton has the upper hand after reaching level 6 and without proper items, so we advise not overreaching until then.
